decisions.reason: As a large German plastics manufacturer, a newly launched large bulk container with its own product page is likely a strategic core offering and would usually be given time to build sales rather than being withdrawn quickly.

The bulk-container valve is a close complement to the container range and, with dedicated website presentation, is likely kept to support system sales even if initial standalone volumes are still ramping up.

A used packaging take-back service is easier to adjust or scale back than a physical product, but in Germany it fits customer service and sustainability expectations, so the firm would more likely retain it than exit within a year.
